Proof

\sketch ↗ def:geodesic ↗ thm:levi-civita-connection Differentiating $B_\lambda (\mu (s))=B_\lambda (x)-s$ at $s=0$ gives $\langle abla B_\lambda (x),\mu '(0) angle =-1$. Differentiability and the $1$-Lipschitz bound imply $|\langle abla B_\lambda (x),v angle |\le 1$ for every unit $v$, by testing along unit-speed geodesics. Equality in Cauchy–Schwarz then forces $ abla B_\lambda (x)=-\mu '(0)$.

□

Proposition
[Busemann function has non-positive Laplacian]
